name: Statfjord WAG (water-alternating-gas injection)
description: largest oil field in the North Sea at start-up (production began 23 Nov 1979); injection converted from water-only to WAG in the late 1990s

sources.note: Equinor news, 17 Mar 2003: "Statfjord's injection system was converted in the late 1990s from water alone to water alternating gas (WAG)". Field facts from norskpetroleum.no/en/facts/field/statfjord (start-up 1979, WAG pressure support, depressurisation from 2007); both read 2026-10-28
